name: Enterprise Work Item and Backlog Binding
constraints: WM-ACT-006 owns WorkItem identity, state, history, assignments, estimates and evidence-bearing outcomes.
WM-XCT-021 owns lifecycle definitions and permitted transitions; WM-ACT-003 is deferred alignment only.
Backlog membership and rank never mutate WorkItem identity or workflow state.
Tracker containers resolve to authoritative project, programme, portfolio or requirement masters before such claims are made.
Accepted outcome requires explicit acceptance authority, criteria revision and evidence.
Backlog is a non-normative correlated view and has no independent model identity.
holds: Backlog identifier allocation is prohibited pending independent-identity proof.
Canonical publication is held by base readiness.
